primary_carrier: Random Matrix Theory (RMT) for ζ-zero statistics

carrier_definition.carrier: C_RMT(N,T)=(M_N, Z_T), with M_N a random GUE/CUE matrix and Z_T the zero-ordinate data {gamma_j: 0<gamma_j<=T}
carrier_definition.matrix_side: GUE Hermitian eigenvalues or CUE unitary eigenangles, scaled to mean spacing 1
carrier_definition.zeta_side: Riemann zero ordinates gamma_j, cleanly normalized only after RH places zeros on the critical line
carrier_definition.role: statistical comparison/evidence carrier, not a native closure carrier

RMT_residual_definition.name: Xi_RMT
RMT_residual_definition.definition: statistical distance between RMT predictions and zeta-zero data
examples: L2 distance between pair correlation functions
moment discrepancy for characteristic-polynomial / zeta moment predictions
RMT_residual_definition.closure_meaning: Xi_RMT=0 means exact/asymptotic statistical agreement with the chosen RMT ensemble, not RH closure

CRE_status_audit.T3a_equivalence_to_RH: no: exact RMT statistical agreement is not logically equivalent to RH and does not imply all zeros lie on the critical line without an additional theorem
CRE_status_audit.RH_dependency: standard zero-statistics statements use RH or critical-line zero ordinates to define a single ordered normalized sequence
CRE_status_audit.closure_interpretation: conditional consistency/evidence after RH-style normalization, not a proof residual for RH

Dichotomy_applicability_audit.reason: RMT predicts statistical laws for zeta zeros; it does not define an L_C whose RH analog is being closed by Xi_RMT
Dichotomy_applicability_audit.domain_refinement: Framework dichotomy applies to RH-analogous closure carriers, not statistical evidence carriers

classical_theorems_cited.source: Montgomery 1973, Pair correlation of zeros of the zeta function
classical_theorems_cited.use: pair-correlation theorem/conjecture; standard formulation conditional on RH for restricted test functions
high-zero numerical confirmation of GUE statistics
CUE characteristic-polynomial model for zeta moments
domain: typed closure carriers for RH-analogous statements
